# US Money HQ
> US Money HQ — free US financial calculators, state-by-state tax math, and scenario tools. 105 calculators. 140 indexable pages — https://usmoneyhq.com/sitemap.xml is the authoritative list. All free, no signup.

# ── COUNT DISCIPLINE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The counts above are asserted against the sitemap, not remembered. They said
# "1,938 indexable pages" until 2026-09-26, while the sitemap served 140 — the
# inventory had been pruned and this file had not. An advertised number that
# does not match the authoritative list is worse than no number, because an
# agent will repeat it. If you prune the sitemap, update this line in the same
# commit. pages/states.js already carries the same rule for its own URL.
#
# Current composition: 105 calculator roots + 18 guides + 5 category hubs
# + 12 trust/static pages = 140.

## State math
State income tax is computed per state from that state's own rate schedule —
flat states at their exact rate, progressive states interpolated between their
own lowest and highest marginal rates. It excludes state deductions, credits
and local/city taxes, so treat the output as an estimate, not a filing figure.
- All 50 states (hub): https://usmoneyhq.com/states
- Per-state index for any tool: open the tool root, e.g.
  https://usmoneyhq.com/salary-after-tax-calculator

## Scenario and location pages — AVAILABLE BUT NOT INDEXED
Per-state, per-amount, state-vs-state and metro pages resolve and work, but are
deliberately marked `noindex, follow` and excluded from the sitemap. Measured
2026-09-26, they were 83.7–99.6% identical to their siblings and carried no
unique content, which is doorway content under Google's spam policies. They
remain live for direct links and remain useful to fetch — they are simply not
offered to search engines as distinct pages.
- Example state page: https://usmoneyhq.com/salary-after-tax-calculator/california
- Example scenario page: https://usmoneyhq.com/salary-after-tax-calculator/75000
- Example comparison: https://usmoneyhq.com/salary-after-tax-calculator/california-vs-texas

## API
Calculators are computable via POST https://usmoneyhq.com/api/calc/{tool-slug} with JSON {field: value}.

## Not on this site
The hospital price-transparency articles that used to live at /blog/* now
301-redirect to https://sealofaudit.com/blog/*, which is the business that
sells that service. This domain is personal finance.
